title: staehelina arborescens
intro: Staehelina arborescens, commonly known as the tree staehelina or Staehelina arborescens, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is a shrub or small tree with medicinal properties. The health benefits of Staehelina arborescens include its use in treating fever, inflammation, and cough. The plant's therapeutic actions are due to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, which exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, while the bioactive compounds also include flavonoids and phenolic acids.
